name: Browser (Playwright)
summary: Open web pages in a real browser, click and fill forms, and show you what it sees.
description: Lets her open web pages in a real browser, click, fill forms and read what she sees, using Microsoft's Playwright. Sara has her own browser tools; this one is for coders who want Playwright's.
about: Playwright's tool server drives a browser on this computer. It reads pages through their accessibility tree, so it is quick and needs no pictures.
Looking at a page runs on its own; clicking, typing and running scripts ask you first. Its code comes from npm (@playwright/mcp, version 0.0.84); we tested that version.

mcp.name: playwright
guide: It uses Google Chrome installed on the computer where Sara runs; it does not download one. On a server without Chrome, install Chrome there first (or ask the Sara team for another browser option).
Add this tool server, then press Test.

changes: Says it needs Google Chrome on the computer where Sara runs (it does not download a browser).
reviewNotes: Started on Windows 11 with Sara 2.57.0: initialize and tools/list answered with 25 tools.
